LanguageData.Coagulopathy.label: coagulopathy
LanguageData.Coagulopathy.description: Impaired clotting increases bleeding and can cause spontaneous hemorrhages. Treat its causes, including cold, acidosis and hemodilution; use blood rather than excess saline to restore blood volume.
